exposure.needed: whether any HelmRepository v1beta2 object (or a status update written by a controller) has status.artifact set without status.artifact.digest; status is written by the controller at runtime and does not appear in static manifests

consequence.statement: In the source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2 HelmRepository schema, status.artifact.digest is now a required field, so the API server rejects objects or status writes that set status.artifact without a digest.
consequence.remediation: Make sure every client or controller that writes HelmRepository v1beta2 status fills in status.artifact.digest.

assertion.statement: The source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2 HelmRepository CRD schema now requires status.artifact.digest, so objects that leave it out are rejected.

checks.detail: source.toolkit.fluxcd.io HelmRepository status.artifact.digest is in the schema of both releases
source.toolkit.fluxcd.io HelmRepository status.artifact.digest becomes required in the v1beta2 schema
